name: NAC Prep in Palisades 2026

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

information: Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest to the competition. The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side. Proceeds from this competition support the Flushing Glow Community Center.
